reasons: Reads as ground (terrain exempt from top rule).

The same weed + yellow lane-dash cluster is stamped 3 times (top-right ~x30-38,y3-12; right ~x40-48,y14-22; bottom-left ~x14-24,y26-34) with identical shape: obvious copy-paste repetition that will tile visibly.

No 'long crack': the only break is a dark blob/pothole at left (~x2-12,y16-22); asphalt base is uniform salt-and-pepper noise with no wear direction, tyre tracks or patch seams. Flatter and noisier than Beodeul paving, which has structured slabs and edge highlights.
reviews.fix: Draw one continuous branching crack (dark core + 1px lighter lip) across the tile, weeds growing only out of the crack at varied sizes, a single worn lane-paint fragment, and break the noise into larger worn/patched areas with 2-3 value bands.

reasons: Overall silhouette reads as a two-storey front elevation: a row of dark window slots at rows 3-8 along the back wall, a cornice band at rows ~36-38, then ground-floor windows and door below. The 'interior floor' (rows ~10-34) has the same grey-speckle value and texture as the walls, so it reads as façade wall, not a floor seen from above.
Collapsed corner (right middle, ~x52-80,y14-44) is a transparent hole: the floor just ends into void instead of showing rubble/ground, which breaks the 3/4 volume.

Quality: whole surface is single-scale speckle noise; wall-top rim, floor and front face differ by at most ~1 value step. Beodeul house next to it has clear roof/wall value separation and structured material; this looks flat and dirty rather than ruined.
reviews.fix: Make the wall tops a thin light rim (2px) with a darker inner wall face, give the interior floor a distinct darker/warmer value with debris and floor tiles, remove windows from the back-wall strip (or show them as holes in a thin wall top), and fill the collapse with a rubble slope that meets the ground, not transparency.

reasons: Tarp (rows ~2-20) has a uniform diamond crease lattice and straight vertical side edges with a horizontal beam across row 0-1, so it reads as a hanging curtain/backdrop in front elevation, not a sloped roof plane seen from above (independent eyes 12/12 agree).
No visible tarp thickness/front lip or sag, no shadow the roof casts on the opening; poles only appear in the bottom rows.
Bedroll (lower-left) is a side-view cylinder; crate shows a tan top only 1-2 rows. Tarp uses ~4 teal values with flat fill; texture is a regular pattern rather than cloth folds.
reviews.fix: Foreshorten the tarp into a trapezoid sloping toward the viewer (wider and lighter at the back ridge, darker at the front edge), add a 1-2px front hem with sag between poles, drop the top beam, let poles show tops at the front corners, and cast a shadow band inside the opening.

reasons: 16x48 column of identical brown rectangles with grey tick marks: reads as a brick wall/ladder or bookshelf, not sandbags. Each 'bag' is a flat brown fill with one grey highlight dash; no bulge, no tied ends, no rounded top-to-front transition.
Only ~10 colours; the 'bulging top + short front' is not legible (top and front are the same brown). No distinct end face at the bottom (rows 44-47 are just a dark line).
Dark near-black outline along both long sides reads as a sticker edge.
reviews.fix: Draw individual pillow-shaped bags with a lighter rounded top (3-4 rows), a darker front 1-2 rows, staggered courses with gaps, a visible tie/seam, and a proper end stack at the south end showing the bag ends; outline in dark burlap tone, not near-black.

reasons: Body is a single mottled brown mass; the 'roof' (rows ~2-11 centre) has nearly the same value as hood/sides, so no top plane separates from a front/side face.

Two black vertical bars + two black slots read as a car seen from the front/back (pillars and headlights) or a face, not an east-west car from above. Wheels are dark half-ellipses on the bottom edge, side-view style (independent eyes 12/12 'not 3/4').
Quality: uniform rust speckle noise everywhere, 19 colours, max luminance 132 - the whole object is murky and lacks highlights; Beodeul props have clear lit tops.
reviews.fix: Lay the car out like the modern-city police car reference: long lighter roof slab in the upper half with empty window-frame outlines around it, hood/trunk planes lighter than the side, a 4-6 row darker side band with door seams, and only the tyre bottoms peeking under the side. Add scorched black areas as shapes, not uniform noise.

reasons: Side windows and a cab windshield sit in the upper band (rows ~4-10 and right end), so the upper band is the vehicle's side, not its roof: this is a side profile with a sliding-door outline, not a 3/4 top view (12/12 independent eyes).
Wheels are round-topped side-view tyres at the bottom edge.
Rust is scattered orange flecks on a flat grey fill; 'long flat roof top' has no lighter plane or roof edge.
reviews.fix: Add a clearly lighter roof slab (6-8 rows) occupying the top, with the windshield as a thin foreshortened strip at the cab end of the roof, then a darker side band below it with door seam; rust as patches with darker edges; tyres only as bottoms under the side.

reasons: Leg section (rows ~26-64) is a straight front elevation, which is acceptable, but the platform top (rows 0-17) is illegible: the left object reads as a small person (brown hair rows ~9-12, blue torso rows ~13-16) rather than a sandbag/crate - characters must not be baked into chipset props.
'Tarp roof corner' (top-right teal block) is a flat rectangle with no thickness or edge, and the plank floor of the platform is only visible as a few rows; sandbag rim is not readable.
Legs and braces are flat 3-4 tone brown with wide transparent gaps; footings ok. Next to the Beodeul well it looks thin and schematic.
reviews.fix: Replace the person-like object with clearly bag-shaped sandbags along the rim, show the platform plank floor as a lighter foreshortened plane with plank lines, give the tarp a lip and shadow, and add value steps/grain to legs and bracing.

reasons: Seat surface (bark top) is a single light row (row ~3); the rest is a side-view cylinder, so the 'seat seen from above' is not given 3-8 rows of top plane.
Sawn end ring is shown full-face on the west end, which is a side/end view; from a south-above camera it should be a foreshortened ellipse partly hidden.
Quality: only 11 colours, flat brown fill with sparse dots, near-black bottom outline; Beodeul wood bench beside it has more value steps and grain.
reviews.fix: Make the top bark band 4-6 rows with a lighter, slightly worn flat sitting strip, the front band 3-4 rows darker, end cut as a narrow foreshortened ellipse with rings, bark grain lines along the length, and outline in dark wood tone.

reasons: At 16x16 the stack is a dark muddle: max luminance 141, 12 colours, top ring and tread sides differ by ~1 step so the top ellipse barely separates from the stack.
Weeds in the hole read as a green 'face' (three dots) in the top ring; the leaning tyre is a 1-2px sliver at the right edge.
Tread bands are flat horizontal stripes with no ribbing; looks like a dark barrel/robot rather than tyres.
reviews.fix: Give the top tyre a clearly lighter rubber top surface ring (worn grey) around a dark hole, add tread blocks on the side bands, separate each tyre with a dark gap line, make the leaning tyre show its ellipse, and let weeds spill over the rim irregularly.

reasons: Two crates side by side; no 'crate on top' visible as described. Lids occupy only rows ~0-5 and are barely lighter than the fronts (right green crate lid is the same green as its front with a dark slot), so they read as chests/cabinets in front view (8/12 independent eyes).
Front faces are flat 3-tone fills with two dots as handles; plank seams barely shown; little weathering for 'salvage'.
Tan highlight strip on left lid is partial and reads as a drawer edge.
reviews.fix: Make lids 5-7 rows clearly lighter with plank lines running across and nail dots, darken fronts with slat gaps and corner battens, stack a smaller crate on top so its own lid and front show, add chips/stencil/rust nails for wear.

reasons: Pole is short and almost straight; the 'bent over to the side' is not readable - at 1x it reads as a desk lamp/mushroom with a teal blob, toy-like.

Hood oval (rows ~7-11) is a cap plate that overhangs, which satisfies the column cap rule, but the base plate at bottom and the hood are similar size/value so the read of height is lost; 58% of the canvas is empty.
Few value steps on the rusty pole (2-3), large flat fills on hood and base.
reviews.fix: Use the full 32px height: tall pole rising from the base ellipse, sharp kink near the top with the pole bending sideways and down, hood plate hanging angled with a dark underside and broken glass shard; add 4-5 values of rust/metal along the pole.
